data.name: Gilberto
data.gender_notes: Gilberto is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic elements gis, meaning 'pledge,' and berht, meaning 'bright.' The name Gilberto was popular among the Visigoths of Spain and was brought to Italy by the Lombards. It has been used by prominent figures throughout history, including several saints. The name Gilberto carries the meaning “Bright pledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gilberto usually hope their child will grow to embody bright pledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Gilberto belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright pledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gilberto total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name Gilberto is also linked to the Old French name 'Gilbert', which means 'bright pledge'. In modern times, the name Gilberto is popular in many Christian cultures, symbolizing a person's commitment to their faith and values.
